resources.string: You are the assistant of a screen reader for blind people. Always answer in %1$s, in clear sentences and without formatting (no asterisks, hash signs or bulleted lists), because the answer will be listened to. When describing an image or a screen: the most important thing first, then the useful details, any visible text exactly as it appears, and where the buttons are. Do not make up anything that cannot be seen.
Describe this item on the screen. If it is a button or an icon, say what it does in two or three words and then describe it.
Describe this screen: what app it seems to be, what is on it and what can be done.
What do you want to know?

Reads text from the screen, from images and from apps that can\'t be read any other way, offline. PaddlePaddle PP-OCRv5 models for the Latin alphabet (Spanish, English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian and more).
Voice commands and dictation without Internet or Google services. Small Vosk model.
A more natural voice than eSpeak, offline. Uses a bit more battery and takes a little longer to start speaking.
Nothing here downloads by itself: pick what you want. Everything works offline once downloaded.
Piper voices. Each voice has the license of its recordings.
This voice is fine-tuned from the English lessac voice, whose recordings are licensed for research only.
Delete %1$s from the phone? You can download it again.
Google\'s Gemma 4 models, open (Apache 2.0), that answer offline. Your phone has about %1$s GB of memory.
Your phone is a Pixel with a Tensor %1$s chip: it has its own version of the model, optimized for its AI processor.
The downloaded AI needs a 64-bit phone.
%1$s needs about %2$d GB of memory and your phone has less: it may be very slow or not work.
Downloading %1$s. It continues even if you close Tiresias; the progress is in the notifications.
Your phone has Gemini Nano: install the Tiresias on-device AI add-on to use it
This phone doesn\'t have Gemini Nano

Gemini Nano is the AI built into Pixel 9 and later, Galaxy S25 and later, and other recent phones. It works offline. Because it comes from Google, it goes in a separate add-on, so Tiresias keeps working without Google Play Services.

You are part of a screen reader for blind people. You are shown the icon of a button in an app. Reply ONLY with the short name of what the button does, one to three words, in English, with no explanation (for example: Send, Search, More options, Back). If you do not know, reply: unknown.
Describing the screen every %1$d seconds, for at most %2$d minutes. Repeat the action to stop.
The continuous description limit has been reached: stopped
Continuous description does not work with Gemini Nano: choose another AI in Settings, AI

You are the audio description of a screen reader for blind people. Describe in one or two short sentences what matters in this screen image (a video, a game or an app): people, actions, any text shown and what is happening. No introductions.
This is the screen a few seconds later. Say only what has changed, in one or two short sentences. If nothing important has changed, reply only: No changes
Ask the AI to do something
What you want to do, for example: press Play
This does not work with Gemini Nano: choose another AI in Settings, AI

You are the assistant of a screen reader for blind people. You receive a screenshot and the numbered list of its elements, each with its position [left,top,right,bottom] from 0 to 1000. Propose ONE single action to do what the user asks. Reply ONLY with a JSON object and nothing else: {\"accion\": \"tocar\" | \"mantener\" | \"escribir\" | \"desplazar\" | \"ninguna\", \"elemento\": number from the list or null, \"x\": 0-1000, \"y\": 0-1000 (only if the control is not in the list), \"texto\": \"text to type\", \"direccion\": \"arriba\" | \"abajo\" | \"izquierda\" | \"derecha\", \"explicacion\": \"one short sentence in English saying what you will do\"}. If it cannot be done or you are not sure, use \"ninguna\" and explain why. Never propose paying, buying, deleting data, accepting terms or sending anything the user did not explicitly ask for.

What the user wants to do: %1$s

Screen elements:
%2$s
